description: Capability -> port -> implementation registry for the plugin host surface. One entry per host-api op plus one per host.call capability. status: ready = registered and implemented; preview = registered with a fallback/no-op/partial implementation; undeclared = implemented or reachable but missing from catalog/host-api.v1.json.

entries.name: exec
entries.notes: Spawns a host process on the plugin behalf; no official plugin calls it and it is not in host-api.v1.json.

entries.name: artifact.preview
entries.notes: Ops artifact.preview.open / artifact.preview.close.

entries.name: artifact
entries.notes: Ops artifact.readText / artifact.writeText; broker-level calls are rejected, only editor sessions serve them.

entries.name: storage
entries.notes: kv.* and settings.* are live; database.execute / database.query are declared but unimplemented.

entries.name: log
entries.notes: All four levels are accepted and discarded.

entries.name: events
entries.notes: Also accepts events.publish, which is not in host-api.v1.json.

entries.name: conversation
entries.notes: draft.insert is implemented but not registered in host-api.v1.json.

entries.name: collaboration
entries.notes: Operations role.*, team.*, space.* are dispatched here; the whole family is absent from host-api.v1.json. Impl has no application:: reference.

entries.name: workspace

entries.name: browser
